decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks build directly on the firm's dental-lab material and custom-manufacturing knowledge, so the firm can interpret early results and improve the line.
PETG thermoforming blanks are closely related to existing thermoforming and dental material capabilities, giving the firm the absorptive capacity to learn and keep improving the product.
UV-curing lacquer has only a brief website mention and is less central to the firm's custom-device and digital-manufacturing knowledge, limiting its ability to assimilate results and improve it.
The intraoral contrast spray fits the firm's digital dentistry workflow and had dedicated page support, so its relatedness supports continued learning and retention despite limited later visibility.
Custom earmolds leverage the firm's existing custom-device manufacturing and hearing-care channels, enabling the firm to interpret results and refine the product line.
Custom hearing protection earmolds draw on the same earmold and hearing-care capabilities, providing the related knowledge needed to keep and improve them.
